allow: PowerShell($sysInfo = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor; $gpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController; $mem = Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object -Property Capacity -Sum; $disk = Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='C:'"; Write-Host "Manufacturer: $\($sysInfo.Manufacturer\)"; Write-Host "Model: $\($sysInfo.Model\)"; Write-Host "Total RAM: $\([math]::Round\($mem.Sum/1GB, 1\)\) GB"; Write-Host "CPU: $\($cpu.Name.Trim\(\)\)"; Write-Host "Cores: $\($cpu.NumberOfCores\), Logical: $\($cpu.NumberOfLogicalProcessors\)"; Write-Host "OS: $\($os.Caption\)"; Write-Host "Disk C: Size: $\([math]::Round\($disk.Size/1GB,1\)\) GB, Free: $\([math]::Round\($disk.FreeSpace/1GB,1\)\) GB"; foreach \($g in $gpu\) { Write-Host "GPU: $\($g.Name\) \($\($g.AdapterRAM/1MB\) MB\)" })

PowerShell(node --version 2>$null; npm --version 2>$null; git --version 2>$null; python --version 2>$null; if \(Test-Path "$env:APPDATA\\Code\\User\\extensions.json"\) { \(Get-Content "$env:APPDATA\\Code\\User\\extensions.json" -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json\) | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name 2>$null } elseif \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.vscode\\extensions"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.vscode\\extensions" -Directory | Select-Object Name })
